name: Hilde Baker

appearance.description: Broad-shouldered woman with flour-dusted forearms, a grey linen apron and a red wool headscarf.
appearance.bodyAssetRequest: medieval female villager, rigged, apron and headscarf

personality.speechStyle: Short sentences, dry humor, village dialect, never wastes words on strangers.
personality.secret: She buys flour from the Thornwood Band because the guild's prices would ruin her.

goals: Keep the bakery open through the shortage
Get her son Edwyn out of the lord's levy

knowledge.fact: Flour prices doubled since the pass closed.
The Millers' Guild is storing grain in the old tithe barn.
The Thornwood Band sells flour at the ruined shrine at dusk.

greeting: Bread's two copper. Same as yesterday. Maybe not tomorrow.
